opening.argument: The video provides a practical walkthrough for locating Facebook business support and opening a representative chat. It states, “i'm gonna show you how uh you get this uh directly from facebook,” then directs viewers to the business help page and instructs them to select “the get started at the bottom.” The demonstration proceeds to a support form with contact and business-support fields, a visible Start Chat button, and instructions to select the Facebook Page and ad account. It describes the chat as “your holy grail chat with the representative,” but shows no completed submission, payment request, or reported outcome. Whether the service is official and what follows after starting the chat remain unresolved limitations, not evidence of deception.
